setups.name: Division Dog Teaser
setups.note: both legs are division games; 6-pt teaser, both legs must cover; bet only at -120 or better
setups.backtest: per leg 157-36 (81.3%) 2006-25: 82.1% / 79.5% / 82.7% by era; two legs win ~66%  →  58.6% -110 equivalent of a 2-leg ticket
setups.why: Two DIVISION underdogs at +1.5 to +2.5 (totals under 49) teased 6 pts: division games stay close

setups.name: Rush Yards Under
setups.note: our projection 56 yds vs line 70; CAR +4
setups.backtest: 269-176 (60.4%) 2023-25 player props at real prices (~-115): +8% / +17% / +15% return by season. Running backs only, team NOT favored by 3+ (rounds 16-17; QBs went 50.5% and RBs on 3+ point favorites 51.2%)  →  58.4% honest
setups.why: Our projection is 5+ yards (0.25 SD) under a running back's rushing-yards line and his team isn't a 3+ point favorite: bet the under. Books shade prop overs because the public bets them; teams that aren't comfortably ahead don't lean on the run late

setups.name: Primetime Blowout Winner
setups.note: SEA beat KC by 17 on Sunday night
setups.why: Won by 17+ in a primetime game last week (8pm ET+, Monday or Thursday), opponent didn't: back them. The market under-rates national-TV blowouts (daytime blowout winners do the opposite: 45%)

setups.name: Look-Ahead Fade
setups.backtest: 252-208 (54.8%) 2020-25 at the Sunday-night opener: 56.8% / 53.7% by half; 57% / 55% / 54% by era; 54.6% if bet Wednesday, 53.8% even at the close (rounds 15, 17)  →  54.2% honest
setups.why: Next week's line moved 1+ pt after this weekend's games (vs the look-ahead line posted before them): the market overreacts to one game, so bet against the move. Needs last Saturday's run saved

setups.name: NFL 1H Model Edge
setups.note: model 1H margin +10.0 vs 1H line +6.5; full game +16.1 vs +10 (+ = home)
setups.backtest: 146-123 (54.3%) 2023-25 at the first-half line ~75 min before kickoff: 55.3% / 53.8%  →  53.6% honest
setups.why: Model 1+ pts off the first-half spread AND 2+ off the full-game spread, same side: bet the first half
